items.t: Italy Clears Tesla’s Assisted Driving Ahead of the EU. Here’s What a Europe Rollout Could Add
items.sum: Key TakeawaysItaly gave provisional approval to Tesla Assisted Driving ahead of the EU, and Tesla (TSLA:NASDAQ) plans to charge €99 a month for it. Italy alone is a small prize, but every 100,000 European subscribers would add about €119 million a year.
